rubricDesc.analysis: We compare solutions and explain what the choice is made of.
rubricDesc.practice: Checklists, work order and acceptance: what you can apply tomorrow.
rubricDesc.report: From the plant and the site: how it really works.
rubricDesc.interview: A conversation with the person responsible for the result.
rubricDesc.people: Stories of professionals and teams you would want to work with.
rubricDesc.projectStory: How a site came together, from the brief to handover.
rubricDesc.materials: Properties, tests, a glossary and the choice for the task.
rubricDesc.opinion: A column: a point of view with arguments.
rubricDesc.week: The main news of the week with sources.
rubricDesc.numbers: A few numbers that explain the week.

magazine.authorsLede: The editors and industry practitioners whose materials appeared in the issues.
magazine.aboutSourcesBody: News comes with the source and the time of the event. Materials are prepared by the editors and industry practitioners; this is a synthetic demonstration.
magazine.aboutVersionsBody: An issue fixes the order and versions of its materials. Corrections are published openly: you can see what changed and when.
magazine.aboutFormatsBody: The online version adapts to any screen; the PDF is laid out separately for saving and printing.
